name: Hamburger Buns

steps.title: Prepare Sponge
steps.description: Mix 270g of the bread flour, all water, and all yeast on low speed until a cohesive mass forms.

steps.title: Ferment Sponge
steps.description: Cover tightly and ferment at 27°C for 3 hours, then refrigerate overnight (12–24 hours).

steps.title: Final Dough Mix
steps.description: Add remaining bread flour, milk, softened butter, sugar, salt, and malt syrup to sponge. Mix on medium speed until medium gluten development. Dough should be smooth and elastic.

steps.title: Bulk Fermentation
steps.description: Cover and ferment at room temperature. Perform one fold after 30 minutes.

steps.title: Divide and Shape
steps.description: Divide dough into 125g portions. Shape into round rolls and place on parchment-lined sheet pan.

steps.title: Final Proof
steps.description: Proof at 27°C until slightly springy and well aerated.

steps.title: Egg Wash and Seed
steps.description: Brush buns with egg wash and apply seeds if desired.

steps.title: Bake
steps.description: Bake in a convection oven at 190°C (375°F) with low fan speed for 25–30 minutes until golden brown. Core temperature should reach 90–93°C (195–200°F).

tagline: Soft, seeded, worth the overnight wait
notes: Core temperature should reach 90–93°C (195–200°F). Dough can be frozen after shaping. Yield excludes toppings. Sponge uses 270g of the total 770g bread flour.
